desc: Read N and S from stdin.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo 998244353 up to N.
Parse S into a rooted tree with a dummy root (stack-based, handle indices 1..N).
Process nodes in reverse order of creation (children before parents).
For each node, compute a sorted tuple of child type IDs to identify its isomorphism type, using a dictionary to assign unique type IDs.
For each node, compute f(v) = factorial(k) * product(inv_factorial[m_t] * pow(f(t), m_t, MOD) for each unique child type t) modulo MOD.
Print f(root) as the final answer.
